newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE shares little changed in slow holiday week.
newsitem.headline: UAE shares little changed in slow holiday week.

text.p: Shares on the informal United Arab Emirates stock market ended the week to Thursday little changed, with the index closing a touch firmer, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index rose 3.04 points to 2,461.80. Brokers said trade was limited due to the national holiday celebrations on December 2 and 3.

The week's two most active stocks were al-Khazna Insurance and the Dubai Investment Company. Al-Khazna dipped to 310 dirhams from 320 a week earlier, while Dubai Investment Company was steady at 13.5 dirhams.
Market leader telecommunications company Etisalat was unchanged at 955 for the fifth week running.
The Oman and Emirates Investment Company ticked up 0.5 dirhams to end the week at 9.5 dirhams.
The Abu Dhabi National Insurance Company rose five dirhams to 1,030 while the Emirates Insurance Company was unchanged at 610 dirhams.
Among banking stocks, the Abu Dhabi National Bank continued to climb, gaining three dirhams to close at 430. The Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank rose to 328 from 325 a week earlier.
Dubai Islamic bank remained at 173 dirhams.
